name: Impcaller on the action bar is saved as Call: Hellfire Imp (#5469)
contract: AscensionCompatData::TalentReplacements (AscensionTalentReplacementData.h:35) carries {17, 17, 706755, 804883, {{707666 at 0}}}: in Defiance specialization 17, knowing the Impcaller talent 706755 turns Call: Hellfire Imp 804883 into Impcaller 707666. AscensionClassService::SynchronizeTalentReplacements (AscensionCompat.cpp:884-953), run from OnPlayerLearnSpell (AscensionCompat.cpp:5782-5784), teaches 707666 with learnSpell(707666, true) (AscensionCompat.cpp:945), a temporary spell never written to character_spell, and registers it over Call: Hellfire Imp with Player::SetTemporarySpellReplacement (AscensionCompat.cpp:951). Before the fix Player::_SaveActions wrote 707666, and Player::_LoadActions at the next login runs before the class service teaches it again, so the button was refused and deleted. persisted_action_button reads Player::GetSavedActionButtonSpell, the id _SaveActions writes. A button holding Impcaller must be saved as Call: Hellfire Imp; a button holding Call: Hellfire Imp is saved unchanged.

steps.label: The talent replaces Call: Hellfire Imp with Impcaller
The Impcaller button is saved as Call: Hellfire Imp
Control: an ordinary known spell is saved unchanged
